name: Moraug, Fury of Akoum
oracle_text:
Each creature you control gets +1/+0 for each time it has attacked this turn.
Landfall — Whenever a land you control enters, if it's your main phase, there's an additional combat phase after this phase. At the beginning of that combat, untap all creatures you control.
blocked_sentences: Each creature you control gets +1/+0 for each time it has attacked this turn.

needs.what: a per-object value for the number of times a given permanent has been declared as an attacker this turn, usable as a static `buff` amount evaluated separately for each affected creature (each creature you control gets +N/+0 where N is that creature's own attack count this turn)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `attacked_this_turn` in value_keys counts players/creatures that attacked (and as a selector key it is only a boolean has-attacked flag); `combats_this_turn` and `attackers_this_turn` are turn-wide totals, not per creature; static_value_keys has no per-affected-object attack count at all, so a `buff` static cannot vary its amount by which creature it is modifying
